scope: Fixed-world counterfactual diagnosis; no new algorithm or RL training
case_selection: All 14 existing safe-success witnesses, all existing one-step rescues and damages; first two both-success cases per scene in the existing 164-root order. No selection using new outcomes.
timing: Execute all 80 actions on each of five roots; unsafe timing branches are marked and excluded from all scientific legal-action summaries. Reuse timing data afterwards.

P1.actions: All candidates with original predicted clearance >= 0.2; preserve and separately report native empty-safe-set fallback
P1.continuation: Frozen repaired GRU; same history, last executed action, absolute clock, human tape, native termination and safety rules
P1.return: G_omega^pi, native discounted realized return, gamma=0.99; not legal-observation conditional expected Q
P1.reuse: Exact selected/forward branches from completed value-contrasts.json, after verifying first executed command and root identifiers
P1.prefix_rule: For difficult roots without any safe successful one-step branch, replay saved safe-success trace commands for each prefix length then resume repaired GRU. Check original candidate membership, smoothing and safety at every forced step.
P1.go: Repeated legal one-step losses or legal multi-step rescues justify the already-defined P2/P3 attribution, not method development
P1.kill: No replicated task loss beyond normal-success controls: stop new mechanism claims and preserve evidence

P2.regression: Within-root demeaned (predicted Q - realized G) versus action progress; cluster bootstrap whole original cases, 2000 draws, seed 20261011
P2.decision_effect: Report success/contact and realized regret, not slope significance alone
P2.limits: Privileged one-world errors do not by themselves prove conditional expected-value error under legal observations

P3.candidates: Same original selected and maximal-progress executed commands on the 38 roots
P3.reuse: Reuse existing fixed-input value trajectories; RL-2000 full continuations already available
P3.new_measurement: Each older checkpoint's own repaired deployment continuation after each fixed first action
P3.limits: No claim of monotonic self-reinforcement; old original RL replay missing; own-policy returns are not historical MC labels

P4.question: Can frozen final-GRU features correct held-out fixed-world pair rankings, and does changing only evaluation-policy label source change that correction? Not historical-cause identification.
P4.execute_if: At least two independent cases have safe better one-step actions; otherwise stop untargeted value fitting
P4.features: Frozen RL-2000 actual-next legal-history features, original selected/forward pair only
P4.coverage: Identical pair observations in both arms; case100..119 fit, case120..139 held out. Never split roots within a case.
P4.labels: Nonterminal V targets=(G-r)/0.99; terminal candidates excluded from fitting and separately evaluated
P4.fit: Same original head initialization, same frozen features, anchored linear least squares: mean squared error + 0.01*||head-original_head||^2, bias included; exact solve, no tuning
P4.go: Held-out pair-ranking correction supports limited feature correctability or policy-source sensitivity only; no new method or automatic follow-up
P4.kill: No held-out improvement: stop this fitting diagnostic; not proof of insufficient raw inputs
P4.limits: Expanded counterfactual coverage is common to both fitted arms but differs from original training. Neither arm reconstructs original historical labels. No causal claim of original RL self-reinforcement.

safety: Separate native collision from true swept geometric contact; keep failures and unsafe-action timing controls
stop: Any mismatch/nonfinite value/traceback stops the current run; preserve engineering evidence. No automatic additional experiment after P1-P4.
